title: Privacy Policy
intro: We are committed to protecting your personal data in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act). Last updated: 30 January 2025.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: This Privacy Policy explains how CKG Flavorz Foodtech Pvt Ltd collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our services via our website and our Android and iOS applications.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.lede: We collect only the information necessary to provide you with the best service possible.

items.title: Basic Information
items.description: Name, email address, phone number, and other contact details.

items.title: Payment Information
items.description: Credit/debit card details, payment method, and billing address.

items.title: Order Information
items.description: Details about your orders, including items purchased, delivery addresses, and payment information.

items.title: Device Information
items.description: Information about the device you use to access our services, such as IP address, browser type, and operating system.

items.title: To Provide Services
items.description: To process and fulfil your orders, including payment processing and delivery.

items.title: Customer Support
items.description: To respond to your inquiries and provide customer support.

items.title: Improving Services
items.description: To analyse and improve our services, including personalising your experience and improving app performance.

items.title: Legal Compliance
items.description: To comply with legal obligations, including tax laws and regulations.

items.title: Marketing & Communication
items.description: To send you promotional offers, newsletters, and other communications, subject to your consent.

items.title: Service Providers
items.description: We may share your data with third-party service providers who assist us in providing our services, such as payment processors and delivery partners.

items.title: Delivery Partners
items.description: To complete the delivery of your orders, we share necessary information, such as your name, delivery address, and contact details, with our delivery partners.

items.title: Legal Requirements
items.description: We may disclose your data if required by law or to protect our rights, property, or safety.

items.title: Data Security
items.description: We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction.

items.title: Data Retention
items.description: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by applicable laws.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.lede: Under the DPDP Act, you have the following rights regarding your personal data.

items.title: Right to Access
items.description: You have the right to access your personal data held by us.

items.title: Right to Correction
items.description: You have the right to request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.

items.title: Right to Erasure
items.description: You have the right to request the deletion of your personal data under certain conditions.

items.title: Right to Data Portability
items.description: You have the right to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.

items.title: Right to Restrict Processing
items.description: You have the right to request the restriction of processing your personal data under certain conditions.

items.title: Right to Object
items.description: You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: How to Exercise Your Rights
sections.body: To exercise any of your rights, please contact us at help@kokofresh.in. We are committed to providing prompt and effective support — follow our escalation matrix below for efficient resolution.

items.title: Changes to This Policy
items.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated policy will be posted on our app and website. Your continued use of our services after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the new policy.

items.title: Contact Information
items.description: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact CKG Flavorz Foodtech Pvt Ltd at help@kokofresh.in or visit kokofresh.in.

closing.heading: Your Privacy Matters
closing.body: We’re committed to protecting your data and maintaining your trust. Shop with confidence knowing your information is secure.
